source.document: Mecobalamin tablets 500 µg "TCK" package insert; Rozebalamin review report

key_sections_summary: Oral 1500 mcg/d in 3 doses; insert silent on renal; PMDA 2024 review (IM 50 mg): exposure ↑ with RI, no adjustment incl. severe; t1/2 ~3 h IM; renal excretion main route.
